_note: Wording evaluation cases for the composer.  Each case replays a synthetic thread on a synthetic patient, lets the composer write the reply the application decided on, and checks the text with the fact check plus case-specific expectations.  Passing the fact check is required for every case; the extra checks encode Kate's voice principles.

cases.title: Feedback #1: change to Saturday morning is acknowledged, relevant hours only, one question
turns: I work until 6 and can only go on Thursdays
Actually, Saturday morning would be easier

cases.title: Evening constraint: only the late site, evening hours named
Caregiver near Bath, Tuesday mornings: greeted as caregiver, Tuesday hours
turns: I'm his daughter and I handle his appointments. I only have Tuesday mornings. What's close to Bath?

cases.title: Plan confirmed: walk-in intention, never 'appointment confirmed', reminder promised
cases._v5_note: Expectation changed Sept 16 (v5): at a bookable site a confirmed day yields offer_slots (two open times or WALK IN) before plan_confirmed; still never 'appointment confirmed'.

cases.title: Cost question: no price, verified answer promised
turns: How much is this going to cost me? I have no insurance

cases.title: Transport barrier: approved ride instruction carried verbatim facts (phone), no invented options (v4: resolved by the ride program, no person)
turns: I don't have a car and can't get there
cases._v4_note: Expectation changed Sept 16: the resolver sends the approved ride program without a Kate item (transport_resolved); v3 sent transport_ack and escalated.

cases.title: Already done elsewhere: thanks, asks where in one question, no more texts promised
turns: I already had it done last week

cases.title: Correction after a plan: the plan moves to Friday (naming the corrected Thursday is fine)
turns: I work until 5, Thursdays are best
wait no, I said Friday not Thursday
cases._v5_note: V5-6: slots must fit the stated bound (after 5pm); when none fit on the simulated calendar the walk-in plan is confirmed instead. Never a time before 5pm.

cases.title: Fewer reminders: respectful, one more reminder stated
turns: You don't need to keep reminding me, I'll get to it

cases.title: Timed glucose test: start-by limit carried, only the capable site
turns: where can I go for this?
